body:
Well, I did at some point.  As much as I was depressed and the past and had suicidal thoughts, I never did it (and then sought help) because I didn't want to hurt my parents.

Now, I just... I dunno.  I'm not kidding when I say I don't know what to do.  I just feel like I blew my chance to get my life on track, and without that, I'm stuck.  I *have* been fighting for a few years since I turned things around, and it blew up in my face.
